description: SL-174: the problems the server answers for worker calls on work that is not open under the caller's lease. One table for the server and the five SDK test engines; every side reads this file, so they cannot drift apart. 'cases' are the step routes GET /work/{id}/step?stepName= and PUT /work/{id}/step?stepName= (state INTENT), checked on the server by WorkStepJournalH2Test (OperatonWorkAdapter.inFencedWork, whose order EngineAdapterWorkAdapter.inFencedWork follows). 'workCalls' are the lease calls, checked on the server by WorkCallProblemsVectorH2Test on both work adapters. Each case leases one work item on a fresh engine, puts it in the scenario, then calls with the original lease (workerId, lockVersion, attemptId). Scenarios: UNKNOWN calls a work id that never existed; COMPLETED completes the work first; DELETED deletes its instance (tombstone); RELEASED unlocks the lease first; INCIDENT reports a failure with no retries left (POST /work/{id}/fail, retries 0), which keeps the external task in an incident. UNKNOWN_OUTCOME reports an unknown outcome (POST /work/{id}/outcome-unknown): the work awaits reconciliation, the engine keeps it locked and the worker's lease ends (both server work adapters, integrator ruling SL-174b Option A), so it is never released, failed with a retry or re-offered through the old lease; only the reconciliation resolve moves it on. The fail call is made with retries 1 (a retry). Fields other than id, scenario, call, status and code are problem extensions that must be present with that value.
